surveys_published_fields.name: surveys_published_fields
surveys_published_fields.value: "surveys"."stage" = 'draft' OR ("surveys"."activity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "surveys"."opens_at" IS NOT NULL AND "surveys"."closes_at" IS NOT NULL)

task_logs_status.name: task_logs_status
task_logs_status.value: "task_logs"."status" IS NULL OR "task_logs"."status" IN ('예정됨', '진행 중', '검토 요청', '완료')

users_class_requires_grade.name: users_class_requires_grade
users_class_requires_grade.value: "users"."class" IS NULL OR "users"."grade" IS NOT NULL
